A bond of 55% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, an farming party cannot recycle one pool of capital across 43 aliases, and each one needs its own funded ocean account. That bill is paid per identity, so 278 aliases cost 142 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
